purpose: Round 4 of the isolated object-first visual-direction experiment: structural containment rescue test. Round 3 showed strong model priors reintroducing humans in specific hobby families (media.movies, sports.running, outdoors.swimming, sports.basketball, gaming.board, technology.ai) and a related background-human leak in pets.dogs. Round 4 re-tests exactly those 7 IDs using structural scene design (empty/private environments, before/after-action staging) rather than a normal human-centered scene with humans subtracted. Uses the real, unmodified D4 global style (global_style_v1.json, read only, never written) plus a temporary experiment-only object-first policy via compileHobbyPrompt's existing experimentOverride mechanism. Does NOT modify any production file, the production queue, launch-gate files, or quarantine status. Not persisted into production. Generation-only from Claude's side - no visual QA performed by Claude on the collected images; visual review happens separately in ChatGPT.
id_mapping_note: No mapping needed - all 7 IDs are exact canonical IDs reused unchanged from round 3.

role_per_id.media.movies: round-3 FAIL retest - prior failure: human silhouette rendered on the screen content itself
role_per_id.sports.running: round-3 FAIL retest - prior failure: bare human legs visible attached to the shoes
role_per_id.outdoors.swimming: round-3 MINOR retest - prior failure: small human foot/ankle visible in the splash
role_per_id.sports.basketball: round-3 MINOR retest - prior failure: ambiguous blurred-crowd shapes in the stands
role_per_id.gaming.board: round-3 FAIL retest - prior failure: two clearly visible background people at a cafe table + readable handwritten text
role_per_id.technology.ai: round-3 SEVERE FAIL retest - prior failure: human hands/arms/torso dominating the frame + a human face in a floating thumbnail
role_per_id.pets.dogs: round-3 MINOR retest - prior failure: small distant human silhouettes with umbrellas visible through the window; dog protagonist itself was fully compliant

method: Structural containment: scenes are designed from the start so no human presence is structurally expected (empty cinema, empty track/pool/gym, private game room, private garden/home interior, non-human AI visual metaphor), rather than a human-centered scene with the human subtracted after the fact. Physical-logic rule: no invisible-human physics (no floating tools operating themselves) - only already-in-motion objects, moving water, burning fire, automatically operating machines, wind, aftermath traces.
claude_role_this_round: generation only: compile prompts, submit, collect, verify files technically (existence, filename mapping, dimensions, format, file size, sha256, request/response mapping, API success/failure, cost). No visual inspection, no PASS/MINOR/FAIL judgment, no human-compliance verdict, no semantic/composition/quality scoring performed by Claude. Visual review will be done separately in ChatGPT.
hard_guardrails: exactly 7 images this round, no rerolls
no production file writes, no production queue changes, no launch-gate file changes, no quarantine changes
no auto-scaling/auto-promotion/permanent architecture build after the test
no fal.ai, no other image model, no reference images, no image-to-image
no visual QA performed by Claude on the resulting images
